name: Shark x Shark
source:
A strange pirate ship have been reported roaming on the sea for the past few months, terrorizing every ship it meets. As the hero, Aqua Tail has a duty to investigate the ship and see what's happening.

Unfortunately, thing does not go as well as he hope.

[From [url=https://throyce.itch.io/sharkxshark]Itch.io[/url]]
